description: Full ANZCTR record for one trial by its ACTRN (e.g. "ACTRN12626001215314" or the 14 digits alone): titles, recruitment status, phase, study design, health conditions and condition codes, intervention and comparator, primary/secondary outcomes, eligibility, target sample size, key dates, primary sponsor, funding sources, ethics committees and secondary IDs. Contact-person details are not returned. To FIND ANZCTR trials by keyword, condition or intervention, use ictrp_search with registry "ANZCTR" (the WHO ICTRP index of this registry), then pass a returned ACTRN here.

actrn.description: ANZCTR registration number, with or without the "ACTRN" prefix — 14 digits, e.g. "ACTRN12626001215314".

name: anzctr_trial
